actual_result: Governing texts, v2 source result/commit paths, reader interface and v3 interface message read. No import/compile/AST/tests/execution of any subject.

frozen_design.module: NEW RUN/control/parent_release_caller_v1.py; stdlib only (hashlib, json, math, os, stat); definitions plus empty in-memory process-lifetime ledgers at import; no I/O/clock/process/signal/environment at import; never imports PRT.
frozen_design.prt_binding: At call time read PRT3 bytes from RUN/control/parent_release_v3.py through the ORIGINAL reader with cap exactly PRT3_BYTES, require sha256==PRT3_SHA256 (source constant written only after owner's final SHA) and not in forbidden {v1,v2}; compile(dont_inherit) and exec those same in-memory bytes into a fresh namespace; call only public decide_and_commit(spec, reader.read_bytes, census, owned_date, commit_dir, deadline_check). No v2/v1 fallback, no parent-supplied function object, no private PRT helper reuse.
public_interface: retain_reader(reader)->None: strong, never-removed process-lifetime retention of every original reader
record_unresolved(source:str, detail:str)->None: permanent parent-recorded unresolved resource
resource_report()->dict: union of every retained reader report()['unresolved'] plus recorded and caller-own unresolved; unavailable report => unresolved
invoke_release(owner:dict, spec:dict, reader, census, owned_date, deadline_check)->CallerOutcome
CallerOutcome: read-only object minted only inside this module; .state RELEASED|HELD; .report() JSON-shaped
ReservationAccount: hold(item, allocation, reservation); release(outcome, receipt_ref)->dict; report()->dict. Accounting only, no scheduler/admission.
frozen_design.owner_rules: item/allocation/reservation typed-exact equal detached spec fields; allocation.record.item==item and reservation_bytes==reservation.bytes; commit_dir/receipt_dir normalized absolute aifours-boundary paths, neither equal to nor below spec artifacts.job_dir (job_dir missing/invalid => refusal); sources exact {caller,reader} refs with reader sha == 1fc8f00c...; prerequisites exact frozen name set, each ref to a parent attestation document read through the original reader.
frozen_design.prerequisite_doc: Pinned bytes, strict JSON, fields format 'parent-release-cp1-prerequisite-v1', prerequisite==name, item==item, allocation_line_sha256==allocation.line_sha256, status 'DISCHARGED_BY_PARENT'. Recorded as PARENT_ASSERTED_NOT_SOURCE_AUTHENTICATED. Missing/invalid => HELD before any PRT invocation.
invocation_steps: S0 retain reader in global ledger FIRST, then nonce os.urandom(32), original deadline check
S1 callables + reader structurally bound to the identical original deadline predicate
S2 owner shape; S3 bounded own preflight, canonical serialization identical to PRT spec_sha definition, strict reparse (detached spec), cross-binding
S4 pinned PRT3 load; S5 declared source pins; S6 prerequisite attestations; any S1-S6 failure => HELD, PRT not invoked
S7 deadline check, invoke PRT3; Exception => HELD; non-Exception BaseException => attach HELD outcome and re-raise, no further callback/I/O

S8 deadline check then verify FULL returned v3 result: state/decision RELEASED, release_effective true, ACK_OK, registry APPENDED/RELEASED/fsync/closed/line_complete, final_deadline_check PASSED, causes [], parts all PASS, not crossed, resources live0/unresolved_total0, uncertainty null
S9 disposition readback through original reader: exact bytes/sha/name/inode, v3 format, RELEASED, spec_sha256 == caller digest, reservation

S10 registry readback: complete LF lines, allocation line unique, target line unique after it, row v3 RELEASED bound to disposition/allocation/reservation, remaining 0, no later same-item row, only earlier v3 HELD same-allocation rows
S11 global unresolved join (all retained readers + recorded + caller-own) must be empty

S12 deadline check; S13 exclusive receipt (anchored NOFOLLOW dir walk, O_CREAT|O_EXCL|NOFOLLOW 0444, every native completion followed by original check, readback, one close per handle with nested cleanup, dir fsync)
S14 receipt ACK through the original reader + identity; S15 global unresolved join again
S16 assemble complete outcome, FINAL original deadline check, only then O(1) registration as effective and return; any failure => HELD outcome, partial files preserved
frozen_design.receipt: parent-release-caller-receipt-v1 'prt-caller-v1-<slug>-<sha256>.json' binding nonce, item, allocation, reservation, spec sha/bytes, PRT3 path/sha/bytes, declared source pins, prerequisite refs, disposition path/sha/bytes/inode/recorded_at, registry path/line_sha256/line index, result format/sha256, ledger snapshot digest. Not authority by itself; no own timestamp (copies disposition owned-date text, labelled).
frozen_design.consumer: ReservationAccount.release requires the identical minted effective outcome object (not a dict/copy), unconsumed/unlatched, a held entry typed-equal to it, receipt_ref equal to its receipt, fresh receipt readback via the outcome's retained original reader under the outcome's retained ORIGINAL deadline predicate (no new deadline accepted), binding equality, clean global unresolved join, final deadline check; success moves exactly that reservation to released once. Any failure latches HELD; never reads registry/disposition syntax as release.
frozen_design.cause_families: CP1_* ordered tuple (owner/spec/reader/source/prerequisite/deadline-by-stage/PRT exception/result/readbacks/unresolved/receipt write/ACK/internal/base) and AC_* for the consumer.
frozen_design.boundaries: Native syscalls and callbacks can stall past the deadline; checks follow completion, no hard-real-time proof. In-process Python code can forge objects; minting prevents accidental dict/copy use, not hostile in-process code. Process restart/module reload loses outcomes and in-memory unresolved history (reservation then stays HELD; persistent history is external). Receipt/registry/disposition bytes never authenticate origin.

blocker: PRT3 source SHA/bytes not yet frozen by ParentReleaseTxn; caller source will be created (mode x) only after the final SHA so the pin is real, never a placeholder.

authority: No runtime, release or scientific authority. Global HOLD unchanged.
